description: This file defines the `InvalidCustomValueException` class, a custom exception used within the OpenMRS platform to indicate errors during conversion between serialized attribute values and their typed representations.

classes.name: InvalidCustomValueException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending APIException, thrown when serialized attribute values are invalid for their expected handlers.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific error message.
